'''Mullu Kurumba''' ({{ipa|kpb|muɭːu kurum(b)ɐ|ipa}}) is a [[Southern Dravidian languages|Southern]] [[Dravidian languages|Dravidian language]] closely related to [[Malayalam language|Malayalam]].

==Geographical distribution==
 
According to Ethnologue, approximately 25,000 Mullu Kurumba speakers are situated in the [[Sultan Bathery|Sulthan Bathery]] and [[Vythiri]] [[tahsils]] in the Wayanad district of Kerala; and the remaining more than 1,000 are situated in Erumad and Cherangodu villages of the [[Gudalur, Nilgiris|Gudalur]] [[Tahsil]], [[Nilgiri District]], [[Tamil Nadu]].
